rules.statement: An action for partition of land can be instituted without the production of the certificate from a Conciliation Board which is referred to in section 14 (1) of the Conciliation Boards Act.
rules.supporting_quote: The only question raised in this appeal is whether an action for partition of land can be instituted without the production of the certificate from a Conciliation Board which is referred to in s. 14 (1) of the Conciliation Boards Act.
